stem:
A student compares the physical properties of the four objects shown.

Which of these physical properties do all four objects have in common?

options.label: F
options.text: They all have the same physical state and conduct electricity.

options.label: G
options.text: They all conduct electricity and attract the same metal objects.

options.label: H
options.text: They all attract the same metal objects and are not soluble in water.

options.label: J
options.text: They all are not soluble in water and have the same physical state.
